task: Classify the crop type of an agricultural land parcel in Slovenia (or that it is not farmland) from Sentinel-2 satellite observations over the 2017 growing season.
dataset_description: Each parcel's time series of four Sentinel-2 bands (BLUE, GREEN, RED, NIR) and six vegetation indices (NDVI, ARVI, EVI, SAVI, NDWI, SIPI) over the season, summarised by statistics; plus terrain elevation (DEM) and slope (INCLINATION). Names are <band or index>_<statistic>: max_val, min_val, mean_val, sd_val of the series; diff_max, diff_min, diff_diff of its differences; max_mean_feature, max_mean_len, max_mean_surf of the interval with the highest mean; pos_* and neg_* (len, rate, surf, tran) of its rising and falling segments: length, rate, area and transitions.
